title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Value of information in Bayes-adaptive MDPs
abstract: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Persistent parameter uncertainty and the value of history.

units.§1: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Problem. An agent faces an MDP whose reward parameter theta is unknown but fixed within an episode. It maintains a posterior over theta and acts on the belief state (Bayes-adaptive MDP).
units.§2: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Proposition 1. With a parameter fixed per episode, history-dependent policies can exceed history-independent policies; the excess equals the value of the information that past observations carry about theta. Assumptions: finite horizon, observed rewards, a prior shared by all policies.
units.§3: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Computation. Small finite instances are solved exactly by enumerating deterministic history policies; the cost grows doubly exponentially in the horizon.

title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Rectangular robust MDPs as per-step games
abstract: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Worst-case treatment of model uncertainty.

units.§1: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Robust MDPs choose a policy against the worst transition model in an uncertainty set.
units.§2: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Theorem 2. Under (s,a)-rectangular uncertainty sets the robust MDP equals a zero-sum game in which nature picks the model adversarially at every step; the robust value is a minimax value.
units.§3: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Limitation. Without rectangularity the per-step game formulation does not hold and the problem can be computationally hard.

title: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Marginalising per-step i.i.d. parameters
abstract: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Per-step randomness integrated into the dynamics.

units.§1: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] When the parameter is redrawn independently at every step it can be integrated out of the dynamics.
units.§2: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Observation 3. Per-step i.i.d. parameters yield an ordinary MDP with averaged transitions and rewards; past observations carry no information about future parameters.
units.§3: [SYNTHETIC FIXTURE] Scope. The statement concerns i.i.d. redraws only; it says nothing about parameters that persist over time.
